title: An Owl's Grip Takes 28 Pounds of Force to Pry Open

scenes.text: It takes 28 pounds of force to open an owl's grip.
scenes.keywords: great horned owl talons close up

scenes.text: That's the great horned owl. A clenched talon needs about 28 pounds of pull to pry open.
A typical door needs less than ten.
The owl uses that grip to snap the spines of its prey.
It hunts hares, skunks, and even porcupines.
A bird of a few pounds, with a grip stronger than a door.

description:
